segments.ja: ウトガルドから戻った者たちは、ウォールの上で短い休息を与えられます。休息の顔ぶれは、エレン、ライナー、ベルトルト、ユミル、ヒストリアです。顔ぶれは同期です。同期のまま、夜の塔の傷を分け合っているように見えます。見えている平和は、穴が無い壁の上で一番危ない種類です。危ないことを、エレンだけがまだ知りません。知らない休息が、今日の舞台です。
segments.en: The people who came back from Utgard are given a short rest on top of the wall. The faces of the rest are Eren, Reiner, Bertholdt, Ymir, and Historia. The faces are classmates. As classmates, they look as if they are sharing the tower's night wounds. The peace that can be seen is the most dangerous kind, on a wall that has no hole. Only Eren does not yet know the danger. The rest he does not know is today's stage.

segments.en: The talk starts from the names of Nanaba and Gelgar. The names are the soldiers who fell first at the tower. Eren receives those names as a loss of the Survey Corps. Beside the ear that receives them, Reiner looks as if he is setting the same names on a different ledger. Eren thinks the visible discomfort is because of fatigue. The thought is kind. The kind thought lets the next sentence through. After it has let it through, fatigue is no longer enough.

segments.ja: ライナーは、鎧の巨人の中身が自分の側にあると、壁の上に置きます。置き方は、叫びではなく、疲れた確認です。確認の隣に、ベルトルトと超大型巨人が同じ文で並びます。並んだ文を、エレンは冗談の処理で一度受けます。処理は失敗します。失敗のあと、同期の顔が五年分の敵の顔と重なります。重なりは、トロストの穴と、森の女型と、今日の壁を一本の線にします。
segments.en: Reiner sets down, on the wall, that the contents of the Armored Titan are on his side. The way of setting it down is not a shout. It is a tired confirmation. Beside the confirmation, Bertholdt and that enormous form line up in the same sentence. Eren receives the lined-up sentence once through the processing of a joke. The processing fails. After the failure, a classmate's face overlaps with five years of an enemy's face. The overlap makes one line of Trost's hole, the Female Titan in the forest, and today's wall.

segments.ja: ライナーが添える理由は、故郷です。故郷は壁の外にあり、彼らを戦士としてこちらへ送った場所です。送られた任務は、人類の敵として壁を破ることでした。破ったあと、彼らは兵士の顔で訓練を生きました。生きた年月が、任務を濁します。濁った任務を、彼は今日、元の言葉へ戻そうとします。戻そうとする声は、罪悪と使命が同じ喉にあります。同じ喉が、エレンには理解の入口になりません。
segments.en: The reason Reiner adds is hometown. The hometown is outside the walls, the place that sent them here as warriors. The mission they were sent on was to break the walls as enemies of humanity. After breaking them, they lived the training with soldiers' faces. The years they lived muddy the mission. Today he tries to return the muddied mission to its original words. The voice that tries has guilt and duty in the same throat. The same throat does not become an entrance of understanding for Eren.

segments.ja: ベルトルトは、ライナーの文を否定しません。否定しないことが、もう一つの告白です。告白の態度は、ライナーより震えがあります。震えは、任務への反対ではなく、友人を敵に戻す痛みです。痛みを、彼はエレンに説明しきれません。しきれないまま、超大型の力が自分の中にあることを黙って認めます。認めた沈黙が、壁の上の空気を変えます。変えた空気の中で、ユミルはどちら側にもすぐには傾きません。
segments.en: Bertholdt does not deny Reiner's sentence. Not denying is another confession. The manner of the confession shakes more than Reiner's. The shaking is not opposition to the mission. It is the pain of turning friends back into enemies. He cannot finish explaining the pain to Eren. Unable to finish, he silently admits that the Colossal's power is inside him. The admitted silence changes the air on the wall. In the changed air, Ymir does not lean to either side at once.

segments.en: At the edge of the talk on the wall, Historia hears the name Reiss. The name she hears is the house that was outside the role of Christa. Talk of the house is postponed until after today's transformation. Even postponed, she is watching Ymir's choice. The choice she watches is whether to go to the warriors' side or remain on the wall's side. Ymir calculates remaining as a way for Historia to survive. The calculation is a different speed from Eren's anger. The different speed is on the same wall at the same time.

segments.en: Before anger becomes a fist, Eren stops in the processing of words. The reason he stops is that the opponent is not a monster but Reiner. Reiner is the face that shared meals, shielded recruits, and put his body on the line at the tower. That face and the Armored Titan's face are connected by a sentence from the same throat. To cut the connection, he repeats a denial. The repeated denial ends up confirming that the other person is serious. At the moment of confirming, the rest on the wall ends.

segments.en: Ymir does not receive the confession as a surprise. Not receiving it is evidence that her past and the word warrior were already next to each other.
